epic.title: North Star Homepage Experience
epic.objective: Implement the Product Owner-approved North Star-inspired homepage skeleton around the dominant Living Office, preserving existing trusted behavior while clearly separating Runtime information, fictional Sample context and informational Preview worlds. EP-06 is homepage/presentation work; real provider integration is reserved for separately approved EP-07 planning.
scope: Deep navy homepage shell, lightweight Office / Agents / Projects region navigation without URL mutation or permanent sidebar, and Studio toolbar.
Original authored richer 320×180 office at integer 2×, decorative empty Meeting/Focus zones and existing Ari/Mina/Sol behavior.
Portrait-first selection, truthful freshness dots, compact dark plaques and exact contextual inspection.
Right-side Sample Recent Activity with three deterministic rows and compact fictional Harbor context.
Studio Current, Retro 70s/Arcade 80s/Cyber 2000 Preview information and in-app stable-scene Expand.
1100×760 and 760×540 responsive/accessibility behavior and integrated fidelity/regression evidence.
out_of_scope: Real providers, provider-specific controls, GitHub integrations, operational history, model/token/cost/productivity metrics.
Separate product pages, routing infrastructure, permanent sidebar, additional agents, new lifecycle states or invented runtime activity.
Functional room membership, occupancy, meetings, pathfinding, autonomous navigation or generalized furniture interaction.
World switching, theme persistence/marketplace, OS fullscreen, new windows or new IPC.
Contract, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload/IPC or renderer trust-policy changes; Sample content in trusted state.
Chat, voice, accounts, notifications, task assignment, orchestration, analytics or repository boards.
design_authority: Original North Star product visual foundation: docs/design/references/north-star/coffee-break-north-star-01.png through coffee-break-north-star-04.png.

Approved EP-06 final homepage and environment package: docs/design/references/ep-06/README.md and its seven images; archived designer-fidelity-report.md explains intent and historical submission status.
Accepted EP-05 implementation/references apply where the approved EP-06 changes do not supersede them; trusted behavior and architecture/security remain authoritative.
Reference images are design targets, not production textures or runtime verification. Product Owner approval supersedes preserved historical NOT APPROVED banners.
architectural_constraints: React owns application composition, controls, focus, accessibility and precise inspection; Phaser owns authored office and presentation. Existing trusted renderer state remains authoritative. No shared-contract, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload/IPC or provider changes are authorized.
Sample and Preview are deterministic renderer-local presentation, never trusted runtime fields or fabricated live history.
Preserve 640×360 office, 320×180 original pixel authorship, integer rendering, canonical identities, lifecycle/coffee/freshness and reduced motion.
Navigation preserves the exact document URL and sender validation; Expand preserves the same mounted scene/canvas without OS fullscreen.
Preserve authentication, token isolation, runtime/session validation, narrow preload, contextIsolation, sandbox and nodeIntegration=false.
One approved story per branch/PR; backlog/import authorization is not production implementation authorization.
visual_principles: Office-first North Star hierarchy: application chrome → toolbar → authored world → precise contextual rail → Worlds/Agents.
Deep navy/blue UI, warm coherent pixel environment, dark plaques, restrained violet navigation, coffee selection and cyan focus.
Truthful Current/Last known/No state dots and text; green means Current, never Online.
Natural document growth, no horizontal page overflow, complete world, and the approved richer selector below the initial compact viewport.
design_workflow: Product intent and approved durable references.
Planner story/engineering scope and explicit implementation authorization.
Developer implementation with relevant tests/visual evidence.
Independent technical review and confirmed-finding correction.
Product Owner acceptance, authorized finalization and maintainer merge.
exit_criteria: All six EP-06 stories are individually accepted and merged.
Integrated homepage matches the approved EP-06 direction with intentional differences documented and reviewed.
Accepted trusted lifecycle, synchronization/recovery, coffee, selection, accessibility, reduced motion and security behavior remain intact.
Sample and Preview are unmistakably non-live and never enter trusted state.
Desktop/compact and expanded behavior are verified with actual runtime measurements/captures and truthful verification limits.
Integrated tests, fidelity evidence, Designer review, independent review and Product Owner acceptance are recorded.
No provider integration or unsupported trust-boundary changes are introduced.

historical_context.title: Verify and Polish North Star Fidelity

stories.title: Establish the North Star Homepage Shell
stories.user_story: As a Coffee Break user, I want a coherent office-first homepage with lightweight navigation, so that I can reach the office, agents and project context without leaving the page.
stories.objective: Establish the approved deep navy homepage composition and Studio toolbar while preserving the accepted Living Office behavior. Prepare regions for later stories without fabricating their content.
scope: Deep navy role-based shell tokens and lightweight top navigation; no permanent sidebar.
Office, Agents and Projects target homepage regions; Projects reserves the contextual region populated by Harbor in US-034.
Studio toolbar with three inhabitants and reserved Expand composition; functional gallery/expansion belongs to US-035.
Desktop and compact document flow retaining the full fixed office and truthful global availability.
dependency_notes: US-030 supplies the accepted runtime, 640×360 office, accessibility and responsive baseline.
Region composition must be stable for later selector, rail and world content. Later-story content is not implemented here.
acceptance_criteria: The shell uses the approved deep navy/blue palette and typography hierarchy from the EP-06 references, preserving coffee selection and cyan keyboard focus.
The header contains lightweight Office, Agents and Projects navigation and no permanent sidebar.
Each navigation control reaches its named homepage region; Projects targets the reserved project-context region rather than opening a new page or inventing a live project.
Activating navigation leaves the document URL unchanged, including its hash, and introduces no router, route store or IPC-policy change.
Navigation does not unmount the office, change selected identity or interrupt trusted runtime presentation.
The office toolbar identifies Studio as the current authored world and reports exactly three inhabitants, never three Online agents.
Expand has its approved toolbar placement; functional expansion is deferred to US-035 and any interim unavailable action is explicitly communicated rather than claiming fullscreen functionality.
The existing 320×180 art at integer 2× remains an intact crisp 640×360 office; no environment or character redraw is introduced.
One truthful global availability region continues to distinguish connected/synchronized, synchronizing, disconnected and retained/no-state conditions.
At 1100×760 outer-window size, the office dominates the desktop composition and space is established for contextual right-rail and lower homepage regions.
At 760×540 outer-window size, the complete office is visible and remaining content is reachable through normal vertical document scrolling without horizontal page scrolling.
The approved richer selector below the initial compact viewport is supported by reachable Agents navigation and document flow; no later-story selector content is invented here.
Navigation controls are native keyboard-operable controls with accessible names, logical traversal and visible focus distinct from selection; focus alone never selects an agent.
Existing mouse/keyboard selection, Clear, exact inspection, reduced motion, reload/remount cleanup and one-canvas behavior remain intact.
stories.boundary: React owns application composition, controls, focus, accessibility and precise inspection; Phaser owns authored office and presentation. Existing trusted renderer state remains authoritative. No shared-contract, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload/IPC or provider changes are authorized.
accessibility_expectations: Use named native navigation controls and semantic section destinations without URL mutation.
Keep focus visible and controls below the initial viewport reachable by keyboard; use normal document scrolling.
regression_requirements: Preserve the original Phaser instance through section navigation and renderer subscriptions outside UI composition.
Preserve availability, trusted inspection, selection/Clear, reduced motion and fixed room size.
definition_of_done: All numbered acceptance criteria are verified with source-grounded tests and applicable actual-renderer evidence.
Relevant regression tests, npm test, typecheck, lint and build pass; pre-existing warnings and unperformed checks are recorded accurately.
Designer implementation review passes against the approved references; intentional differences are documented.
Independent technical review passes and confirmed findings are resolved.
Product Owner accepts the story; one scoped branch and PR is approved and merged through the repository workflow.
No provider integration or changes to trusted contracts, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload or IPC are introduced.

stories.title: Evolve the Living Office Environment
stories.user_story: As a Coffee Break user, I want a richer coherent pixel-art office, so that the workplace reflects the approved North Star environment without implying unsupported room activity.
stories.objective: Author the approved environment on the production logical pixel grid, reconciling furniture, agents, runtime overlays and selection as one fixed scene.
scope: Original authored background/foreground at 320×180 and integer 2× display.
Lounge, two inhabited workstations, coffee area and empty decorative Meeting/Focus zones.
Coordinated geometry and fallback compatibility; preserve anchors where practical, documenting any necessary migration.
dependency_notes: Integrated fit and capture use the US-031 shell/toolbar; accepted US-030 character and presentation behavior remain constraints.
Environment design/pixel authorship can be prepared in parallel with shell work after design agreement, but integration must validate the merged shell baseline.
acceptance_criteria: The environment is newly authored at 320×180 logical pixels; the 1672×941 environment study is used as a visual target, never installed or resampled into a production Phaser texture.
The complete world displays at integer 2× as exactly 640×360 with nearest-neighbor/pixel-art rendering and no fractional scaling.
The room retains the approved warm office/cool boundary visual family, richer grouped furniture, plants, shelving and glass articulation.
The single scene includes recognizable lounge, two workstations, coffee, Meeting Room and Focus Room visual zones matching the approved composition.
Meeting and Focus furniture is empty decoration with spatial labels only; no room occupancy, membership, navigation, pathfinding, extra live agents or new trusted events exist.
Exactly Ari, Mina and Sol remain present, using their canonical identities and existing sprite atlases/lifecycle behavior.
Existing anchors are preserved where practical; any required authored-position migration is minimal, documented and reconciled with all dependent geometry.
Ari and Mina retain coherent seated chair/desk/monitor relationships; Sol remains coherent with the coffee area without an invented workstation.
Both trusted workstation state overlays align with their authored monitor fields across all five lifecycle states, and fallback geometry agrees with their placement.
The permanent mug and canonical coffee steam align; Sol's exact Waiting/activity predicate still controls coffee, while generic Waiting and Idle do not imply coffee.
Background, overlay, agent, selection, label and foreground depths produce correct occlusion without hiding faces, state meaning, selection outlines or interaction targets.
Pointer envelopes and selection outlines remain correctly aligned after any geometry change, with the existing 48×64 displayed pointer target behavior retained.
Live Working/workstation/coffee motion and bounded terminal acknowledgements retain existing semantics; retained state pauses operational loops without losing state meaning.
Reduced motion preserves static equivalents and suppresses the existing operational/acknowledgement motion without new animation timing.
Authored/fallback rendering, explicit scene shutdown, React remount/reload, mouse selection and keyboard equivalents remain functional at both supported window sizes.
stories.boundary: React owns application composition, controls, focus, accessibility and precise inspection; Phaser owns authored office and presentation. Existing trusted renderer state remains authoritative. No shared-contract, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload/IPC or provider changes are authorized.
accessibility_expectations: Keep the scene textual description and native selector equivalent; do not present decorative zones as actionable controls.
Keep labels/readability, selection envelopes and static reduced-motion meaning clear.
regression_requirements: Validate art dimensions/integrity, anchor-overlay-foreground relationships and fallback geometry.
Preserve exact coffee, lifecycle, retained state, motion guards and destruction-safe disposal.

stories.title: Refine Agent Identity and Selection
stories.user_story: As a Coffee Break user, I want recognizable portraits and truthful freshness beside each identity, so that I can select an agent and distinguish current information from retained or unavailable state.
stories.objective: Refine the native selector and in-world labels to the approved portrait-first identity hierarchy while keeping trusted semantics and interaction ownership unchanged.
scope: Canonical portraits with freshness dot, name and lifecycle beneath each portrait.
Compact dark in-world identity/freshness/lifecycle plaques.
Existing selection, Clear, focus, textual equivalents and pointer geometry.
dependency_notes: The shell supplies region navigation and focus conventions; settled environment geometry determines safe plaque placement.
Selector markup can be prepared independently of art, but final labels/hit-area integration require the approved US-032 placement.
acceptance_criteria: The selector contains exactly Ari, Mina and Sol in canonical identity order with no additional or renamed agents.
Each selector uses the canonical 48×48 integer-scaled portrait and presents portrait → freshness dot → name → lifecycle with the name/lifecycle beneath the portrait.
Dark in-world plaques retain persistent identity, truthful freshness and compact lifecycle meaning without placing precise activity text in the world.
Plaques avoid obscuring faces, hands, monitors, selection outlines and pointer envelopes in the approved environment.
A filled green freshness dot means Current only when trusted agent state exists and the current session is connected and synchronized; it never means Online.
Retained trusted state uses the approved neutral Last known treatment, preserves lifecycle/activity/reason, and explicitly remains not live.
No trusted state uses the neutral hollow No state treatment and identity without inventing Idle, activity or availability.
Freshness remains distinct from lifecycle: an Error agent with current trusted information can still be Current.
Freshness dots have textual equivalents in accessible names, shared legend and/or inspection, so meaning never depends solely on color.
Selector buttons remain native keyboard-operable controls with accurate accessible identity and pressed/selected semantics.
Visible cyan focus remains distinct from warm selection; tabbing or receiving focus does not select an agent.
Mouse sprite selection and keyboard Space/Enter selection update the same selected identity and agree with selector, summary and inspector.
Clear selection removes world/selector selection, restores unselected inspection and preserves sensible visible focus.
The existing minimum native control targets and 48×64 displayed sprite pointer envelope behavior remain usable at both target sizes.

Lifecycle/availability updates, responsive changes, reload/remount, reduced motion and exact canonical coffee preserve existing selection and trusted presentation semantics without invented state/activity.
stories.boundary: React owns application composition, controls, focus, accessibility and precise inspection; Phaser owns authored office and presentation. Existing trusted renderer state remains authoritative. No shared-contract, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload/IPC or provider changes are authorized.
accessibility_expectations: Keep native selector controls, textual freshness, visible focus, logical traversal and activation/Clear behavior.
Keep below-viewport compact controls keyboard reachable; do not rely on hover or color.
regression_requirements: Preserve a single React selection authority and existing world/native selection agreement.
Cover Current, Last known, No state, Error-with-current-data and state updates while focused.

stories.title: Integrate the Contextual Right Rail
stories.user_story: As a Coffee Break user, I want precise agent inspection beside clearly labeled example activity, so that I can understand trusted agent information without confusing fictional project context with runtime history.
stories.objective: Compact the contextual inspector and place three deterministic Sample entries with Harbor context immediately beneath it, preserving all exact trusted information.
scope: Contextual inspector with exact trusted fields and all availability/selection cases.
Sample Recent Activity containing Harbor context, three fixed example rows and a native project-context disclosure.
Natural desktop rail and compact document flow with complete long text.
dependency_notes: The shell reserves rail/project regions; the refined selector provides identity/freshness semantics and selection continuity.
Static Sample copy can be prepared in parallel; integrated inspection/selection checks use the merged selector baseline.
acceptance_criteria: The desktop contextual rail contains the compact trusted inspector followed immediately by Recent Activity, with approved hierarchy and spacing.
Selected inspection shows the exact trusted canonical identity, lifecycle, activity and optional reason; unsupported provider, model, token, task or metric fields are absent.
Unselected inspection invites selection without auto-selecting an agent; Clear remains available with existing guarded/unselected semantics.
Retained inspection explicitly says Last known / Not live and preserves exact lifecycle, activity and reason; synchronizing availability does not change lifecycle.
Selected No state inspection preserves identity and says trusted state is unavailable without inferring activity or lifecycle.
Recent Activity has persistent Sample identification and the text 'Fixed example sequence · Not runtime history'.

Recent Activity contains exactly three fixed rows: Ari / Search panel draft opened / H-13 · Example PR #19 / 10:10; Mina / Query privacy ready for review / H-14 · Example PR #20 / 10:20; Sol / Notes search sample updated / H-15 · Example work item / 10:30.
Harbor / Local notes search is compact fictional project context within Sample Activity, not a separate dominant panel or live project integration.

Project-context disclosure presents explicitly fictional repository and branch examples, clearly stating no account/repository/provider is connected; final example strings are recorded during story design without becoming runtime requirements.
Fixed example hours are not converted into relative live recency; Sample rows do not change on trusted runtime updates or imply current agent assignments.
Sample content is deterministic renderer-local presentation and never enters the trusted store, presentation lifecycle, event contracts, Connector or simulator.
Activity/reason and sample copy wrap and grow naturally without truncation or fixed-height clipping; the rail moves subsequent content down.
Native Clear/disclosure controls are keyboard reachable with visible focus, accessible names and stable focus through state updates.
At 1100×760 and 760×540, content stays in approved side/inline flow with usable vertical scrolling, no horizontal overflow, and no fabricated GitHub/provider functionality.
stories.boundary: React owns application composition, controls, focus, accessibility and precise inspection; Phaser owns authored office and presentation. Existing trusted renderer state remains authoritative. No shared-contract, Connector, transport, main mirror, preload/IPC or provider changes are authorized.
accessibility_expectations: Use semantic inspector/activity regions, native disclosure/Clear controls and explicit Sample text.
Preserve complete truthful text, visible focus and normal document scrolling.
regression_requirements: Test exact trusted fields and unselected/retained/no-state cases separately from deterministic Sample content.
Runtime updates must not mutate the Sample sequence or its provenance.

stories.title: Add World Previews and Office Expansion
stories.user_story: As a Coffee Break user, I want to inspect future-world concepts and dedicate more application space to my office, so that I can explore the visual direction while preserving the active office and selection.
stories.objective: Add truthful informational world previews and an in-app expanded office composition, preserving the same Phaser instance, trusted presentation and native focus behavior.
scope: Studio Current and three named informational Preview entries with approved artwork provenance.
Studio toolbar access to the world gallery.
In-app Expand/Exit/Escape composition with stable scene, selection, focus and scroll restoration.
dependency_notes: Toolbar/composition, final office geometry and native selector are direct prerequisites.

US-034 is completed earlier in the recommended integration order so the final right rail can be tested when hidden/restored, but its Sample implementation is not a technical prerequisite for preview/Expand preparation.
acceptance_criteria: Worlds shows exactly Studio — Current, Retro 70s — Preview, Arcade 80s — Preview and Cyber 2000 — Preview.
Studio remains the only current authored production office; its toolbar identity can reach the homepage world gallery without changing the document URL.
Each future-world entry uses approved source artwork or source regions with recorded provenance; original North Star files remain unchanged.
Preview activation reveals useful approved concept information and clearly says the environment is a Preview without functional switching.
Preview controls are usable native keyboard controls with visible focus, named content and a clear dismissal/collapse interaction where applicable.
Preview interaction does not change the scene, agents, selected identity, trusted store or any persistent theme/world setting.
Expand activates an application-owned expanded composition, not OS fullscreen, camera zoom or a new window/IPC capability.
The expanded composition follows the approved study: general navigation, Worlds and Sample Activity are hidden, while toolbar, full office, selector and precise inspection remain available.
The same mounted Phaser game, scene and canvas remain present before, during and after Expand/Exit; no second host or replacement game is created.
The office stays exactly 640×360 at integer scale with no fractional transform or resampling in either composition.
Selected identity and trusted runtime subscriptions continue uninterrupted; lifecycle/activity/availability changes while expanded update the same world/inspection.
A visible native Exit control replaces the expansion action in the toolbar.
Escape exits only while expanded and returns to the normal composition; the handler is removed or inactive outside expansion and during disposal.
Exiting through Exit or Escape restores visible keyboard focus to the invoking Expand control without changing selection.
Exit restores the prior document scroll position after normal layout is restored, without a competing focus-induced page jump.
Desktop 1100×760 and compact 760×540 support entry/exit, complete room visibility and reachable selector/inspection through normal vertical scrolling without horizontal overflow.
Repeated expansion, resize, availability changes and no-selection/retained/no-state cases produce no duplicate listeners/canvases, selection reset or acknowledgement/animation replay.
Expanded and informational-preview interactions preserve reduced-motion static meaning, existing sprite/native selection, Clear, exact coffee and destruction-safe shutdown/reload behavior.

Hidden regions must not leave focus stranded; compact selector and full inspection remain reachable.
regression_requirements: Check the actual game/scene/canvas identity through repeated entry/exit and updates.
Preserve acknowledgement non-replay, runtime continuity, reduced motion, Clear and cleanup; no OS fullscreen or IPC changes.

stories.title: Verify and Polish the Homepage
stories.user_story: As a Coffee Break user, I want the integrated homepage to match the approved design and preserve trusted behavior, so that the expanded product experience is coherent, truthful and dependable.
stories.objective: Record integrated production-renderer fidelity and regression evidence for all six EP-06 stories and address only confirmed, approved polish findings.
scope: Direct runtime captures, real viewport/input records, provenance and design comparison boards.
Integrated lifecycle/freshness/selection/motion/preview/expansion regression verification.
Designer and independent review, Product Owner acceptance and bounded confirmed polish.
dependency_notes: All homepage slices must be integrated on the accepted baseline before final fidelity and regression acceptance.
Earlier stories contribute focused evidence; historical checks may be reused only with explicit source-match/provenance, never relabeled as fresh native observations.
acceptance_criteria: Actual integrated renderer captures are compared against the approved desktop, compact, full compact flow, expanded, retained and keyboard studies with design/runtime provenance labeled.
The authored production environment is compared with the approved environment study and original North Star direction, documenting pixel-grid/occlusion translations and intentional differences.
Capture records identify exact source baseline/tree, full evidence-file hashes, selected identity, input provenance and observations sufficient to reproduce the checks.
Outer window targets 1100×760 and 760×540 use actual measured native/content bounds and viewport dimensions; no fixed 28px title-bar assumption is asserted as runtime measurement.
The complete office remains exactly 640×360 with crisp integer-scaled pixel art in normal/expanded and desktop/compact compositions.

Desktop rail/lower regions and compact room-first flow match the approved hierarchy; below-viewport selectors and full inspection remain reachable through vertical scrolling without horizontal overflow.
Intermediate layout transitions, long exact activity/reason, unbroken text and supported 200% DOM text enlargement preserve readability, selection/focus and natural document growth.
Office/Agents/Projects navigation reaches homepage regions, preserves the document URL and retains the mounted scene/runtime/selection.
All five lifecycle states have observable static/animated meaning consistent with the existing trusted state and exact inspection.
Sol's exact Waiting plus 'Taking a coffee break in the simulated office' produces canonical coffee; ordinary Waiting or Idle does not imply coffee.
Current, Last known and No state cases are evidenced in world labels, selector and inspection, with global availability separate from lifecycle and no Online claim.
Reduced-motion checks preserve static meaning and suppress operational/acknowledgement motion; Chromium emulation and native OS observations are labeled separately.
Mouse world selection, native selector activation, Clear and summary/inspection agree on identity without focus-only selection.
Keyboard traversal, visible focus distinct from selection, Space/Enter activation and focus preservation during state/availability/resize updates are verified at both targets.
World previews are informative and explicitly unavailable for switching; exactly three fixed Sample rows and Harbor context remain unmistakably non-live and independent of trusted state.
Expand/Exit/Escape preserve the same game/scene/canvas and trusted updates, restore invoking focus and prior scroll, and create no duplicate listeners or acknowledgement replay.
Reload/remount and explicit scene shutdown preserve single-canvas cleanup and the accepted synchronization, retained state, recovery and security behavior.
npm test, typecheck, lint, build and git diff --check run on the final tree; exact results, existing warnings and unavailable checks are recorded without fabricated PASS claims.
Designer fidelity review and independent technical review pass with confirmed findings resolved; Product Owner integrated acceptance is explicitly recorded.

Evidence distinguishes real simulator/production captures, synthetic supplemental inputs, derived comparison boards, browser input/media emulation and actual manual native/assistive-technology observations; unperformed native accessibility checks remain unclaimed.
